e)uknh/mis.html: ἐϋκνήμις -ιδος [ἐϋ- 5 + κνημίς.] Equipped with good κνημῖδες. Epithet of the Achaeans Il. 1.17, Il. 2.331, Il. 3.86, Il. 4.414, etc.: Od. 2.72, Od. 3.149, Od. 11.509, Od. 18.259, Od. 20.146. Applied also to ἑταῖροι (of this race) Od. 2.402, Od. 9.60, 550, Od. 10.203, Od. 23.319.

e)canalu/w.head: ἐξαναλύω
e)canalu/w.html: ἐξαναλύω [ἐξ- 1 + ἀνα- 6.] To set free from or from the power of. With genit.: θανάτοιο Il. 16.442 = Il. 22.180.

e)le/fas.head: ἐλέφας
e)le/fas.html: ἐλέφας -αντος, ὁ. Ivory Il. 5.583: Od. 4.73, Od. 8.404. Od. 18.196, Od. 19.56, 563, 564, Od. 21.7, Od. 23.200. A piece of ivory Il. 4.141.

e)niauto/s.head: ἐνιαυτός
e)niauto/s.html: ἐνιαυτός -οῦ, ὁ [prob. the time when the heavens are again ἐνὶ αὐτῷ, in the same position, and thus properly rather an epoch than a period.] A year. 1 Considered as a point or unit of time or as one of a series: ἐννέα βεβάασιν Il. 2.134, δεκάτῳ Il. 12.15 (at the tenth turn of the year, at the end of the tenth year). Cf. Il. 2.295, 551: ὅτʼ ἐ. ἔην (when the turn of the year had come) Od. 10.469. Cf. Od. 1.16, Od. 2.175, Od. 3.391, Od. 11.248, Od. 16.18, Od. 17.327. 2 Considered as a space of time: ἐς δεκάτους ἐνιαυτούς Il. 8.404 = 418 ( see δέκατος 1), πέντε ἐνιαυτούς Il. 23.833. Cf. Il. 19.32, Il. 21.444: τλαίης (τλαίην) ἂν ἐνιαυτόν (for a year) Od. 1.288, Od. 2.219. Cf. Od. 4.86, 526, 595, Od. 10.467, Od. 11.356, Od. 14.196, 292, Od. 15.230, 455.

e)rateino/s.head: ἐρατεινός
e)rateino/s.html: ἐρατεινός -ή, -όν [ἔραμαι. Lovely.] 1 An epithet of general commendation, pleasing, charming, delightful, fair, or the like: ὁμηλικίην Il. 3.175. Cf. Il. 6.156, Il. 19.347, 353, Il. 21.218: δαῖτα Od. 8.61, Od. 20.117, ἑτάροισιν ἐ. (a pleasing sight) Od. 9.230. Cf. Od. 4.13, Od. 23.300. 2 As epithet of places, fair, pleasant Il. 2.532, 571, 583, 591, 607, Il. 3.239, 401, 443, Il. 5.210, Il. 14.226, Il. 18.291: Od. 7.79.

eu)kto/s.head: εὐκτός
eu)kto/s.html: εὐκτός [vbl. adj. fr. εὔχομαι.] In neut. pl. εὐκτά, matter for boastingIl. 14.98.

e)pixri/w.head: ἐπιχρίω
e)pixri/w.html: ἐπιχρίω [ἐπι- 5.] Aor. pple. ἐπιχρίσασα Od. 18.172. 1 To apply unguent to, anoint (one's person or a part thereof): παρειάς Od. 18.172. In mid.: χρῶτʼ ἐπιχρίεσθαι Od. 18.179. 2 To besmear: [τόξον] ἀλοιφῇ Od. 21.179.

e)qelonth/r.head: ἐθελοντήρ
e)qelonth/r.html: ἐθελοντήρ -ῆρος, ὁ [ἐθέλω.] A volunteer Od. 2.292.

e)ph/ritos.head: Ἐπήριτος
e)ph/ritos.html: Ἐπήριτος The name assumed by Odysseus in his tale to Laertes Od. 24.306.

e)gkataph/gnumi.head: †ἐγκαταπήγνυμι
e)gkataph/gnumi.html: †ἐγκαταπήγνυμι [ἐγ-, ἐν- 2, κατα- 1.] Aor. ἐγκατέπηξα. To thrust down into. With dat.: ξίφος κουλεῷ Od. 11.98.

e)/dafos.head: ἔδαφος
e)/dafos.html: ἔδαφος τό. The hull (of a ship) Od. 5.249.

e)pipoimh/n.head: ἐπιποιμήν
e)pipoimh/n.html: ἐπιποιμήν -ένος [ἐπι- 10 + ποιμήν. Cf. ἐπιβουκόλος.] A herdsman Od. 12.131.

eu)rudi/kh.head: Εὐρυδίκη
eu)rudi/kh.html: Εὐρυδίκη Daughter of Clymenus and wife of Nestor Od. 3.452.

e)pistrwfa/w.head: ἐπιστρωφάω
e)pistrwfa/w.html: ἐπιστρωφάω [ἐπι- 14.] To go about among, visit. With acc.: ἐπιστρωφῶσι πόληας Od. 17.486.

ei)/luma.head: εἴλυμα
ei)/luma.html: εἴλυμα τό [εἰλύω.] A wrapper Od. 6.179.

e)/ranos.head: ἔρανος
e)/ranos.html: ἔρανος -ου, ὁ. A feast to which the partakers contributed in shares (cf. εἰλαπίνη) Od. 1.226, Od. 11.415.

e)pistado/n.head: ἐπισταδόν
e)pistado/n.html: ἐπισταδόν [ἐπι- 14 + στα-, ἵστημι.] Going round and standing or stopping by each in turn: νείκεον Od. 12.392. Cf. Od. 13.54 = Od. 18.425. Attending to each detail in succession: δόρπον ὁπλίζοντο Od. 16.453.

e)xe/qumos.head: ἐχέθυμος
e)xe/qumos.html: ἐχέθυμος -ον [ἔχω + θυμός. See θυμός I.4.b.] Controlling one's passions, continent Od. 8.320.

e)pimh/domai.head: ἐπιμήδομαι
e)pimh/domai.html: ἐπιμήδομαι [ἐπι- 5.] To contrive (something) against. With dat.: δόλον ἐπεμήδετο πατρί Od. 4.437.

eu)h/rhs.head: εὐήρης
eu)h/rhs.html: εὐήρης -ῆρες [εὐ- 1 + ἀρ-, ἀραρίσκω.] Well fitted or balanced. Epithet of oars Od. 11.121, 125 = Od. 23.272, Od. 11.129, Od. 12.15, Od. 23.268.

e)/ktose.head: ἔκτοσε
e)/ktose.html: ἔκτοσε [ἐκτός + -σε.] Out of, from. With genit.: χειρός Od. 14.277.

e)pih/ranos.head: ἐπιήρανος
e)pih/ranos.html: ἐπιήρανος [ἐπι- 19 + (ϝ)ήρ. Cf. ἐρίηρος.] Pleasing, grateful: ποδάνιπτρα Od. 19.343.

e)parwgo/s.head: ἐπαρωγός
e)parwgo/s.html: ἐπαρωγός ὁ [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 5 + ἀρωγός.] A protector, helper, aider Od. 11.498.

e)tewneu/s.head: Ἐτεωνεύς
e)tewneu/s.html: Ἐτεωνεύς (κρείων). Patronymic Βοηθοΐδης. θεράπων of Menelaus at Sparta Od. 4.22, 31, Od. 15.95.:

e(/rsh.head: ἕρση
e(/rsh.html: ἕρση -ης, ἡ (ϝέρση). Except in Od. 9.222 with prothetic ἐ, ἐἐρση. 1 Dew Il. 23.598: Od. 5.467, Od. 13.245. 2 In pl., drops of water from a cloud, rain-drops: ὑψόθεν ἧκεν ἐέρσας Il. 11.53. Cf. Il. 14.351. 3 A young lamb or kid newly yeaned Od. 9.222.

ei)seru/w.head: †εἰσερύω
ei)seru/w.html: †εἰσερύω [εἰσ- 2 + ἐρύω1.] Nom. pl. masc. aor. pple. εὶσερύσαντες. To draw into. With acc.: νῆα σπέος εἰσερύσαντες Od. 12.317.

e)kprolei/pw.head: †ἐκπρολείπω
e)kprolei/pw.html: †ἐκπρολείπω [ἐκ- 1 + προ- 1.] Nom. pl. masc. aor. pple. ἐκπρολιπόντες. To quit...and go forward, to issue from: λόχον Od. 8.515.

e)kgela/w.head: †ἐκγελάω
e)kgela/w.html: †ἐκγελάω [ἐκ- 8.] Aor. pple. ἐκγελάσας. To laugh out, laugh aloud: ἡδύ Od. 16.354, Od. 18.35.

e(ch=mar.head: ἑξῆμαρ
e(ch=mar.html: ἑξῆμαρ [ἕξ + ἦμαρ.] For or during six days: πλέομεν Od. 10.80 = Od. 15.476, δαίνυντο Od. 12.397 = Od. 14.249.

e)lph/nwr.head: Ἐλπήνωρ
e)lph/nwr.html: Ἐλπήνωρ A comrade of Odysseus in his ship. Killed by mishap at Circe's house Od. 10.552; his shade begs for funeral rites Od. 11.51, 57; the funeral Od. 12.10.

e)capobai/nw.head: †ἐξαποβαίνω
e)capobai/nw.html: †ἐξαποβαίνω [ἐξ- 1 + ἀπο- 1.] 3 pl. aor. ἐξαπέβησαν. To land or disembark from (a ship). With genit.: νηός Od. 12.306.

e)phgkeni/des.head: ἐπηγκενίδες
e)phgkeni/des.html: ἐπηγκενίδες αἱ [app. ἐπ-, ἐπι- 1 + ἐνεγκέμεν. See φέρω.] Dat. ἐπηγκενίδεσσι. The pieces fitted upon the top of the ἴκρια of the σχεδίη of Odysseus, and forming the upper surface thereof Od. 5.253.

e(ka/stoqi.head: ἑκάστοθι
e(ka/stoqi.html: ἑκάστοθι [ἕκαστος + -θι.] In each place, at each of the spots mentioned Od. 3.8.

e)nqrw/|skw.head: †ἐνθρῴσκω
e)nqrw/|skw.html: †ἐνθρῴσκω [ἐν- 2, ἐν- 3.] 3 sing. aor. ἔνθορε. With dat. 1 To leap into: μέσσῳ Il. 21.233, πόντῳ Il. 24.79. 2 To leap in among: ὁμίλῳ Il. 15.623. 3 To leap against: λὰξ ἔνθορεν ἰσχίῳ (i.e. kicked it) Od. 17.233.

e)ceme/w.head: †ἐξεμέω
e)ceme/w.html: †ἐξεμέω [ἐξ- 1 + ἐμέω.] 3 sing. aor. opt. ἐξεμέσειε. To disgorge, throw up. Of charybdis: ἱστόν Od. 12.437. To vomit forth or throw up waters. Of the same Od. 12.237.

e)ph/retmos.head: ἐπήρετμος
e)ph/retmos.html: ἐπήρετμος -ον [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 2 + ἐρετμόν.] 1 At the oar: ἑταῖροι ἥατʼ ἐπήρετμοι Od. 2.403. 2 Epithet of ships, fitted or furnished with oars Od. 4.559 = Od. 5.16 = Od. 17.145, Od. 5.141, Od. 14.224.

e)pisth/mwn.head: ἐπιστήμων
e)pisth/mwn.html: ἐπιστήμων [ἐπίσταμαι.] Skilful, clever, adroit: ἐ. βουλῇ τε νόῳ τε Od. 16.374.

e(/rmaios.head: Ἕρμαιος
e(/rmaios.html: Ἕρμαιος λόφος. An eminence above the city of Ithaca Il. 16.471.

e)gkru/ptw.head: †ἐγκρύπτω
e)gkru/ptw.html: †ἐγκρύπτω [ἐγ-, ἐν- 1.] 3 sing. aor. ἐνέκρυψε. To put away in. With dat.: δαλὸν σποδιῇ Od. 5.488.

e)/neimi.head: †ἔνειμι
e)/neimi.html: †ἔνειμι [ἐν- 1 + εἰμί.] 3 sing. ἔνεστι Il. 24.240: Od. 10.45. 1 pl. ἔνειμεν Il. 5.477. 3 sing. opt. ἐνείη Il. 2.490, Il. 17.156. 3 sing. impf. ἐνῆεν Il. 1.593. ἐνέην Od. 9.164, Od. 19.443. 3 pl. ἔνεσαν Il. 6.244: Od. 21.12, 60. 1 To be or exist in a specified or indicated place, to be or exist in some person or thing: ὀλίγος ἔτι θυμὸς ἐνῆεν Il. 1.593, οὐκ οἴκοι ἔνεστι γόος; Il. 24.240. Cf. Il. 5.477, Il. 6.244: Od. 19.443, Od. 21.12, 60. 2 To be or exist in. With dat.: εἰ Τρώεσσι μένος ἐνείη Il. 17.156. Cf. Il. 2.490: Od. 10.45. 3 To be available in an indicated place: ἐνέην [οἶνος] Od. 9.164.

e)rista/fulos.head: ἐριστάφυλος
e)rista/fulos.html: ἐριστάφυλος [ἐρι- + σταφυλή.] Of wine, the product of rich grapes, full-bodied Od. 9.111 = 358.

e)pi/sxesis.head: ἐπίσχεσις
e)pi/sxesis.html: ἐπίσχεσις ἡ [ἐπι- 5 + σχε- as ἐπισχεσίη. Cf. ἐπέχω 6.] Holding back, reluctance, hesitation Od. 17.451.

e)pi/frwn.head: ἐπίφρων
e)pi/frwn.html: ἐπίφρων -ονος [app. ἐπι- 5 + φρήν. Applying the mind to something.] 1 Having good sense, well-balanced in mind, shrewd, sagacious Od. 23.12.– 2 Of counsel, wise, shrewd, sagacious Od. 3.128, Od. 16.242, Od. 19.326.

e)pi/tonos.head: ἐπίτονος
e)pi/tonos.html: ἐπίτονος ὁ [ἐπι- 7 + τον-, τείνω.] The backstay of a mast (cf. πρότονοι) Od. 12.423.

e(yia/omai.head: †ἑψιάομαι
e(yia/omai.html: †ἑψιάομαι [from a sb. *ἕψις conn. with L. jocus.] 3 pl. imp. ἑψιαάσθων Od. 17.530. Infin. ἑψιάασθαι Od. 21.429. (ἐφ-, καθ-.) To sport, play: καθήμενοι ἑψιαάσθων Od. 17.530, ὥρη ἑψιάασθαι Od. 21.429.

eu)/maios.head: Εὔμαιος
eu)/maios.html: Εὔμαιος (δῖος, ὄρχαμος ἀνδρῶν ). Odysseus's swineherd (συβώτης, συφορβός , ὑφορβός). Son of Ctesius. Athene directs Odysseus to go to his dwelling Od. 13.404; the dwelling described Od. 14.5, receives Ο. 29; Odysseus tells him his tale Od. 14.192; he tells Odysseus his tale Od. 15.403; receives Telemachus Od. 16.11; is dispatched to tell Penelope of Telemachus's safe arrival 130, returns 452; accompanies Odysseus to the town Od. 17.200, they encounter Melantheus 212, they reach the city 260; he enters Odysseus's house first Od. 17.324; summons Odysseus to Penelope Od. 17.551 ; leaves the house to return to his own Od. 17.604; returns to Odysseus 's house Od. 20.162; sets down the bow etc. before the suitors for the contest Od. 21.80, Odysseus tests him 188, he pledges himself to support Il. 15.203, Odysseus reveals himself 207; he carries the bow to Odysseus that Odysseus may take part in the contest Od. 21.359; during the fight he and Philoetius seize Melantheus in the θάλαμος Od. 22.178, ranges himself by Odysseus for the final fight 201, slays Elatus-2 267 , is wounded by Ctesippus 279, slays Polybus-5 284 ; takes part in the slaying of the unfaithful maids Od. 22.454 ; accompanies Odysseus to the country Od. 23.366; at Laertes) house when Odysseus comes to it Od. 24.363, prepares to fight the oncoming suitors 497, but Athene stops the fight 528; etc.

e)gkosme/w.head: ἐγκοσμέω
e)gkosme/w.html: ἐγκοσμέω [ἐγ-, ἐν- 1.] To arrange or stow in. With dat.: τὰ τεύχεα νηΐ Od. 15.218.

e)ntanu/w.head: †ἐντανύω
e)ntanu/w.html: †ἐντανύω [ἐν- 6.] 3 pl. pres. ἐντανύουσιν Od. 21.326. Fut. infin. ἐντανύειν Od. 21.97, 127. 3 sing. aor. ἐντάνυσε Od. 21.150. Subj. ἐντανύσω Od. 21.114. 2 sing. -ῃς Od. 21.306. 3 sing. -ῃ Od. 19.577, Od. 21.75, 315, 338. 3 sing. opt. ἐντανύσειε Od. 21.286. Infin. ἐντανύσαι Od. 19.587, Od. 21.185, 247, Od. 24.171. Aor. infin. mid. ἐντανύσασθαι Od. 21.403. Fut. infin. pass. ἐντανύεσθαι Od. 21.92. 1 To bend (a bow) into the position required for stringing it, to string (it) (cf. τανύω 2): οὐδὲ τόξον ἐντάνυσεν Od. 21.150. Cf. Od. 19.577 = Od. 21.75, Od. 21.92, 247, 286, 306, 315, 326, 338, 403. Absol. Od. 21.114, 185. 2 To stretch (the string) so as to string a bow: νευρήν Od. 19.587, Od. 21.97 = 127, Od. 24.171.

e)peth/sios.head: ἐπετήσιος
e)peth/sios.html: ἐπετήσιος [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 16 + ἔτος.] Coming on all through the year: καρπός Od. 7.118.

e(rkei=os.head: ἑρκεῖος
e(rkei=os.html: ἑρκεῖος [ἕρκος.] Having his altar in the ἕρκος (see ἕρκος 2). Of Zeus Od. 22.335.

e)leh/mwn.head: ἐλεήμων
e)leh/mwn.html: ἐλεήμων [ἐλεέω.] Pitiful, compassionate Od. 5.191.

e)kpi/nw.head: †ἐκπίνω
e)kpi/nw.html: †ἐκπίνω [ἐκ- 9] Aor. ἔκπιον Od. 10.318. 3 sing. -ε Od. 9.353, 361. 3 pl. -ον Od. 10.237. 3 sing. pf. pass. ἐκπὲποται Od. 22.56. 1 To take a draught, quaff a cup Od. 9.353, 361, Od. 10.237, 318. 2 In pass., to be drunk up, be consumed: ὅσσα τοι ἐκπέποται Od. 22.56.

e)nteu=qen.head: ἐντεῦθεν
e)nteu=qen.html: ἐντεῦθεν [ἐν.] Thence Od. 19.568.

eu)ru/nw.head: †εὐρύνω
eu)ru/nw.html: †εὐρύνω [εὐρύς.] 3 pl. aor. εὔρυναν. To make wide or broad: εὔρυναν ἀγῶνα (marked off an ample space) Od. 8.260.

e)cofe/llw.head: ἐξοφέλλω
e)cofe/llw.html: ἐξοφέλλω [ἐξ- 9 + ὀφέλλω2.] To increase or add to (something offered): ἐξώφελλεν ἔεδνα Od. 15.18.

e)/paulos.head: ἔπαυλος
e)/paulos.html: ἔπαυλος -ου, ὁ [ἐπʼ αὐλῇ.] A fold for sheep, etc. Od. 23.358.

e)pibw/twr.head: ἐπιβώτωρ
e)pibw/twr.html: ἐπιβώτωρ -ορος, ὁ [ἐπι- 10 + βώτωρ. Cf. ἐπιβουκόλος.] A shepherd or goatherd: μήλων Od. 13.222.

eu)hnori/dhs.head: Εὐηνορίδης
eu)hnori/dhs.html: Εὐηνορίδης Patronymic of Leocritus Od. 2.242, Od. 22.294.

e)name/lgw.head: ἐναμέλγω
e)name/lgw.html: ἐναμέλγω [ὲν- 2.] To milk into. With dat.: γαυλοί, τοῖς ἐνάμελγεν Od. 9.223.

e)pike/llw.head: †ἐπικέλλω
e)pike/llw.html: †ἐπικέλλω [ἐπι- 12.] 3 sing. aor. ἐπέκελσε Od. 13.114. Infin. ἐπικέλσαι Od. 9.148. Acc. pl. masc. pple. ἐπικέλσαντας Od. 9.138. 1 To put one's ship on shore, bring her to shore Od. 9.138. 2 Of a ship, to come to shore Od. 9.148. To come to shore on. With dat.: ἠπείρῳ Od. 13.114.

eu)/qumos.head: εὔθυμος
eu)/qumos.html: εὔθυμος [εὐ- 5 + θυμός.] Well-disposed, bountiful: ἄναξ Od. 14.63.

e)pilwbeu/w.head: ἐπιλωβεύω
e)pilwbeu/w.html: ἐπιλωβεύω [ἐπι- 5.] To mock at a person Od. 2.323.

e)kde/rw.head: †ἐκδέρω
e)kde/rw.html: †ἐκδέρω [ἐκ- 3.] Aor. pple. ἐκδείρας. To strip off: δῶκέ μʼ ἐκδείρας ἀσκὸν βοός Od. 10.19 (i.e. a bag made from the stripped off skin).

e)pia/llw.head: †ἐπιάλλω
e)pia/llw.html: †ἐπιάλλω [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 5.] 3 sing. ἐπί̄ηλε. To set on foot, instigate: τάδε ἔργα Od. 22.49.

e(/ptaxa.head: ἕπταχα
e(/ptaxa.html: ἕπταχα [ἑπτά.] Into seven parts Od. 14.434.

e)xe/nhos.head: Ἐχένηος
e)xe/nhos.html: Ἐχένηος A Phaeacian elder Od. 7.155, Od. 11.342.

e)cafu/w.head: ἐξαφύω
e)cafu/w.html: ἐξαφύω [ἐξ- 9 + ἀφύω = ἀφύσσω.] To draw off (wine): οἷνον ἐξαφύοντες Od. 14.95.

eu)ru/nomos.head: Εὐρύνομος
eu)ru/nomos.html: Εὐρύνομος A suitor, son of Aegyptius-1 Od. 2.22, Od. 22.242.

e)chmoibo/s.head: ἐξημοιβός
e)chmoibo/s.html: ἐξημοιβός [ἐξ- 9 + ἀμείβω.] Serving for a change: εἵματʼ ἐξημοιβά (changes of raiment) Od. 8.249.

ei)doqe/h.head: Εἰδοθέη
ei)doqe/h.html: Εἰδοθέη Daughter of Proteus. Encounters Menelaus in Pharos Od. 4.366, her advice to him 371, how he carried it out 431.

e)pii/stwr.head: ἐπιίστωρ
e)pii/stwr.html: ἐπιίστωρ -ορος, ὁ [ἐπι- 5 + (ϝ)ισ-, οἶδα. See εἴδω C. One who has knowledge in a particular line.] Thus app., one with knowledge or experience of something specified: μεγάλων ἔργων (deeds of prowess) Od. 21.26.

e)/mfulos.head: ἔμφυλος
e)/mfulos.html: ἔμφυλος [ἐμ-, ἐν- 1 + φῦλον.] Of one's own tribe: ἄνδρα Od. 15.273.

e)kpata/ssw.head: †ἐκπατάσσω
e)kpata/ssw.html: †ἐκπατάσσω [ἐκ- 1.] Pf. pple. pass. ἐκπεπαταγμένος. App., to afflict (in mind): φρένας ἐκπεπαταγμένος ἐσσί (out of your wits, stirred to madness) Od. 18.327.

ei)da/limos.head: εἰδάλιμος
ei)da/limos.html: εἰδάλιμος -η [εἶδος.] Fair to see, comely Od. 24.279.

e)pi/baqron.head: ἐπίβαθρον
e)pi/baqron.html: ἐπίβαθρον [ἐπιβα-, ἐπιβαίνω.] A return made for a passage in a ship Od. 15.449.

e)/ktoqen.head: ἔκτοθεν
e)/ktoqen.html: ἔκτοθεν [ἐκτός + -θεν 2.] (Cf. ἔκτοσθε (ν).) 1 Outside, without: ἐ. αὐλῆς (outside in the αὐλή, taking αὐλῆς as local genit.) Od. 9.239, 338. Cf. Od. 13.100. 2 Outside the circle of. With genit.: ἐ. ἄλλων μνηστήρων Od. 1.132.

e)llo/s.head: ἐλλός
e)llo/s.html: ἐλλός ὁ. The young of the deer, a fawn Od. 19.228.

e)ggu/h.head: ἐγγύη
e)ggu/h.html: ἐγγύη [cf. ἐγγυαλίζω] The giving of a pledge, an undertaking Od. 8.351.

e)formh/.head: ἐφορμή
e)formh/.html: ἐφορμή ἡ [ἐφορμάω.] A way of attack Od. 22.130.

e)pipi/lnamai.head: ἐπιπίλναμαι
e)pipi/lnamai.html: ἐπιπίλναμαι [ἐπι- 11.] To approach or come near to a specified place: οὐ χιὼν ἐπιπίλναται Od. 6.44.

e)capodu/nw.head: ἐξαποδύνω
e)capodu/nw.html: ἐξαποδύνω [ἐξ- 3 + ἀπο- 1.] To strip off Od. 5.372.

e)kptu/w.head: †ἐκπτύω
e)kptu/w.html: †ἐκπτύω [ἐκ- 1.] 3 sing. aor. ἐξέπτυσε. To spit out of. With genit.: στόματος ἅλμην Od. 5.322.

e)pitolma/w.head: ἐπιτολμάω
e)pitolma/w.html: ἐπιτολμάω [ἐπι- 5.] 1 To steel oneself to endure something Od. 17.238. 2 To steel or resign oneself to do. With infin.: ἐπιτολμάτω κραδίη ἀκούειν Od. 1.353.

eu)lei/mwn.head: εὐλείμων
eu)lei/mwn.html: εὐλείμων [εὐ- 5 + λειμών.] Having fairmeadows Od. 4.607.

e)calao/w.head: ἐξαλαόω
e)calao/w.html: ἐξαλαόω [ἐξ- 9]. 1 To blind Od. 11.103 = Od. 13.343. 2 To take the power of sight from (an eye) Od. 9.453, 504.

e)pitimh/twr.head: ἐπιτιμήτωρ
e)pitimh/twr.html: ἐπιτιμήτωρ ὁ [ἐπι- 5 + τιμη-, τιμάω. One who honours.] A patron or protector Od. 9.270.

eu)ruti/dhs.head: Εὐρυτίδης
eu)ruti/dhs.html: Εὐρυτίδης Patronymic from Εὔρυτος-1. Of Iphitus-2 Od. 21.14, 37.

e)phth/s.head: ἐπητής
e)phth/s.html: ἐπητής App., well-mannered, courteous: οὕνεκʼ ἐ. ἐσσι Od. 13.332, ἐπητῇ ἀνδρί Od. 18.128.

eu)agge/lion.head: εὐαγγέλιον
eu)agge/lion.html: εὐαγγέλιον τό [εὐ- 5 + ἀγγελίη.] A reward for bringing good tidings Od. 14.152, 166.

e)ndoupe/w.head: ἐνδουπέω
e)ndoupe/w.html: ἐνδουπέω [ἐν- 2.] To make a splash or thud in falling into. With dat.: μέσσῳ ἐνδούπησα Od. 12.443, ἄντλῳ ἐνδούπησε πεσοῦσα Od. 15.479.

eu)/botos.head: εὔβοτος
eu)/botos.html: εὔβοτος -ον [εὐ- 5 + βοτά.] Having goodly cattle: νῆσος Od. 15.406.

e)pista/ths.head: ἐπιστάτης
e)pista/ths.html: ἐπιστάτης ὁ [ἐπι- 2 + στα-, ἵστημι. One who stands by or beside.] A suppliant or almsman; or perh., a follower or dependant Od. 17.455.

e)paske/w.head: ἐπασκέω
e)paske/w.html: ἐπασκέω [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 19.] To finish off or complete (with something): ἐπήσκηται τοίχῳ Od. 17.266.

e)lpwrh/.head: ἐλπωρή
e)lpwrh/.html: ἐλπωρή -ῆς, ἡ (ϝελπωρή) [ἔλπω.] Hope. With fut. infin.: ὑπάλυξιν ἔσεσθαι Od. 23.287. With aor. infin.: φίλους ἰδέειν Od. 6.314 = Od. 7.76. Cf. Od. 2.280.

eu)h/nwr.head: εὐήνωρ
eu)h/nwr.html: εὐήνωρ -ορος [εὐ- 3 + ἀνήρ.] That is of service or benefit to men. Epithet of οἶνος (that maketh glad the heart of man) Od. 4.622. Of χαλκός Od. 13.19.

e)piko/ptw.head: †ἐπικόπτω
e)piko/ptw.html: †ἐπικόπτω [ἐπι- 5.] Fut. pple. ἐπικόψων. To bring one's blow to bear upon, strike: βοῦν Od. 3.443.

e)pifrosu/nh.head: ἐπιφροσύνη
e)pifrosu/nh.html: ἐπιφροσύνη -ης, ἡ [ἐπίφρων.] 1 Sagacity or adroitness in an emergency Od. 5.437. 2 In pl., sense or prudence leading one to do something specified: αἲ γὰρ ἐπιφροσύνας ἀνέλοιο οἴκου κήδεσθαι Od. 19.22.

eu)phgh/s.head: εὐπηγής
eu)phgh/s.html: εὐπηγής [εὐ- 1 + πηγ-, πήγνυμι.] Compact of bodily frame, well-knit Od. 21.334.

e)pipre/pw.head: ἐπιπρέπω
e)pipre/pw.html: ἐπιπρέπω [ἐπι- 19.] To have a specified appearance: οὐδέ τοι δούλειον ἐπιπρέπει εἶδος (shows like a slave's) Od. 24.252.

e)/mpaios.head: ἔμπαιος
e)/mpaios.html: ἔμπαιος App., expert in, possessed of: οὐδʼ ἔργων ἔμπαιον (–⏑⏑) οὐδὲ βίης Od. 20.379, κακῶν Od. 21.400.

e)niau/sios.head: ἐνιαύσιος
e)niau/sios.html: ἐνιαύσιος [ἐνιαυτός.] A year old: σῦν Od. 16.454.

e)popteu/w.head: ἐποπτεύω
e)popteu/w.html: ἐποπτεύω [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 14 + ὀπτεύω, fr. ὀπ-. See ὁράω.] (διοπτεύω.) 3 sing. pa. iterative ἐποπτεύεσκε. To go over, visit, inspect: ἔργα Od. 16.140.

e)pentanu/w.head: †ἐπεντανύω
e)pentanu/w.html: †ἐπεντανύω [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 5 + ἐν- 3.] Aor. pple. ἐπεντανύσας. To draw tight (a rope) resting upon something Od. 22.467.

e)ru/manqos.head: Ἐρύμανθος
e)ru/manqos.html: Ἐρύμανθος A mountain range in northwest Peloponnesus Od. 6.103.

e)canafando/n.head: †ἐξαναφανδόν
e)canafando/n.html: †ἐξαναφανδόν [ἐξ- 9 + ἀναφανδόν.] Openly, plainly, clearly: ἐρέω τοι Od. 20.48.

e)pifrone/w.head: ἐπιφρονέω
e)pifrone/w.html: ἐπιφρονέω [ἐπίφρων.] To mark or discern what should be marked or discerned: ὡς σὺ ἐπιφρονέουσʼ ἀγορεύεις (showing good discernment) Od. 19.385.

eu)ru/kleia.head: Εὐρύκλεια
eu)ru/kleia.html: Εὐρύκλεια (περίφρων, φίλη τροφός ). Odysseus's nurse, daughter of Ops. Puts Telemachus to bed Od. 1.429; in charge of the stora-room Od. 2.347, Telemachus bids her prepare provisions for his voyage 348; she encloses the maids while Odysseus and Telemachus remove the arms Od. 19.15; washes Odysseus Od. 19.357, recognizes his scar 392, 467 ; encloses the maids before the fight Od. 21.380; enumerates the unfaithful maids Od. 22.419; brings sulphur Od. 22.480; tells Penelope of Odysseus's return and the slaughter of the suitors Od. 23.1; etc.

e)ph/bolos.head: ἐπήβολος
e)ph/bolos.html: ἐπήβολος [app. with ἐπη- (with metrical lengthening) for ἐπι-, fr. ἐπιβάλλομαι. See ἐπιβάλλω 2.] Having, having the disposal of: νηός Od. 2.319.

e)nipeu/s.head: Ἐνιπεύς
e)nipeu/s.html: Ἐνιπεύς (θεῖος). A river of Thessaly rising in Mt. Othrys and flowing into the Peneius Od. 11.238, 240.

e)pikera/nnumi.head: ἐπικεράννυμι
e)pikera/nnumi.html: ἐπικεράννυμι [ἐπι- 5.] Aor. infin. ἐπικρῆσαι. To mix (wine) with water Od. 7.164.

e)latreu/s.head: Ἐλατρεύς
e)latreu/s.html: Ἐλατρεύς A Phaeacian Od. 8.111 , 129.

e)niau/w.head: ἐνιαύω
e)niau/w.html: ἐνιαύω [ἐν- 1, ἐν- 4.] 1 To pass the night in a specified place: ἔνθʼ ἀνὴρ ἐνίαυεν Od. 9.187. 2 To pass the night among. With dat.: ὕεσσιν Od. 15.557.

e)/nhmai.head: ἔνημαι
e)/nhmai.html: ἔνημαι [ἐν- 1.] To be seated in a specified place: ἵνʼ ἐνήμεθα Od. 4.272.

e)/xetos.head: Ἔχετος
e)/xetos.html: Ἔχετος (βροτῶν δηλήμων πάντων). A mythical destructive king Od. 18.85, 116, Od. 21.308.

e)piklei/w.head: ἐπικλείω
e)piklei/w.html: ἐπικλείω [ἐπι- 5.] To praise, extol, applaud; ἀοιδήν Od. 1.351.

e)piyau/w.head: ἐπιψαύω
e)piyau/w.html: ἐπιψαύω [ἐπι- 5.] To exercise the power of touch in an indicated direction. Fig.: ὅς τʼ ὀλίγον περ ἐπιψαύῃ πραπίδεσσιν (has even a little range with his wits) Od. 8.547.

e)kqnh/|skw.head: †ἐκθνῄσκω
e)kqnh/|skw.html: †ἐκθνῄσκω [ἐκ- 9.] 3 pl. aor. ἔκθανον. To die: γέλῳ ἔκθανον Od. 4.100 (app. (nearly) killed themselves with laughter).

ei)sa/nta.head: εἰσάντα
ei)sa/nta.html: εἰσάντα (only in Od. 5.217), ἐσάντα [εἰσ- 4, ἐσ- + ἄντα.] In the face, face to face: ἰδών Il. 17.334. Cf. Od. 5.217, Od. 10.453, Od. 11.143, Od. 15.532, Od. 16.458, Od. 17.239.

e)nnh/konta.head: ἐννήκοντα
e)nnh/konta.html: ἐννήκοντα indeclinable [ἐννέα. For ἐννε-ήκοντα. Cf. τρι-ήκοντα.] Also ἐνενήκοντα Il. 2.602 (a form difficult to explain). Ninety Il. 2.602: Od. 19.174.

e)pidi/frios.head: ἐπιδίφριος
e)pidi/frios.html: ἐπιδίφριος [as ἐπιδιφριάς.] (Put) on a chariot: εἰς ὅ κε δῶρα ἐπιδίφρια θήῃ (θείω) Od. 15.51, 75.

e(/khti.head: ἕκητι
e(/khti.html: ἕκητι (ϝέκητι) [cf. ἑκών.] By the grace or aid of. With genit. (always following the case): Ἑρμείαο ἑ. Od. 15.319. Cf. Od. 19.86, Od. 20.42.

eu)nh=qen.head: εὐνῆθεν
eu)nh=qen.html: εὐνῆθεν [εὐνή + -θεν 1.] From one's bed Od. 20.124.

e)co/llumi.head: †ἐξόλλυμι
e)co/llumi.html: †ἐξόλλυμι [ἐξ- 9.] 3 sing. aor. opt. ἐξολέσειε. To destroy: τοὺς Ζεὺς ἐξολέσειεν Od. 17.597.

e)pixeire/w.head: ἐπιχειρέω
e)pixeire/w.html: ἐπιχειρέω [ἐπι- 5 + χείρ.] To lay hands upon, apply oneself to. With dat.: δείπνῳ Od. 24.386. Cf. Od. 24.395.

e)feyia/omai.head: †ἐφεψιάομαι
e)feyia/omai.html: †ἐφεψιάομαι [ἐφ-, ἐπι- 5.] 3 pl. ἐφεψιόωνται Od. 19.331. 3 pl. impf. ἐφεψιόωντο Od. 19.370. To jeer at, make fun of, mock. With dat.: τεθνεῶτι Od. 19.331, κείνῳ 370.

eu)dei/elos.head: εὐδείελος
eu)dei/elos.html: εὐδείελος -ον [app. for εὐδέελος, εὔδηλος, fr. εὐ- 4 + δῆλος.] Thus, bright, shining. Epithet of islands: Ἰθάκην Od. 2.167. Cf. Od. 9.21, Od. 13.212, 234, 325, Od. 14.344, Od. 19.132.

eu)rume/dousa.head: Εὐρυμέδουσα
eu)rume/dousa.html: Εὐρυμέδουσα Chamber-maid of Alcinous Od. 7.8.

e)corma/w.head: ἐξορμάω
e)corma/w.html: ἐξορμάω [ἐξ- 1.] Of a ship, to sheer off from her course: κεῖσʼ ἐξορμήσασα Od. 12.221.

e)peru/w.head: †ἐπερύω
e)peru/w.html: †ἐπερύω [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 18 + ἐρύω1.] 3 sing. aor. ἐπέρυσσε. To pull to (a door): θύρην Od. 1.441.

e)fhme/rios.head: ἐφημέριος
e)fhme/rios.html: ἐφημέριος [ἐφ-, ἐπι- 16 + ἡμέρη.] During the day, for that day: οὔ κεν ἐ. βάλοι δάκρυ Od. 4.223. Absol. in neut. pl.: ἐφημέρια φρονέοντες (thinking only of things of the day, limited in outlook) Od. 21.85.

ei)=ros.head: εἶρος
ei)=ros.html: εἶρος τό = εἴριον: ἰοδνεφές Od. 4.135, Od. 9.426.

eu)ke/atos.head: εὐκέατος
eu)ke/atos.html: εὐκέατος -ον [εὐ- 1 + κεάζω.] Readily cleft or split, or perh., deftly split (into billets for burning): κέδρου Od. 5.60.

e)palaste/w.head: ἐπαλαστέω
e)palaste/w.html: ἐπαλαστέω [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 5.] To find things intolerable: τὸν ἐπαλαστήσασα προσηύδα (breaking out) Od. 1.252.

e)lai/neos.head: ἐλαΐνεος
e)lai/neos.html: ἐλαΐνεος (ᾱ) [ἐλαίη.] Of olive-wood Od. 9.320, 394.

e)rifu/lh.head: Ἐριφύλη
e)rifu/lh.html: Ἐριφύλη (στυγερή). Wife of Amphiaraus. Bribed by a golden necklace persuaded Amphiaraus to take part in the expedition of the Seven against Thebes-1 Od. 11.326, Od. 15.247.

e)pika/rsios.head: ἐπικάρσιος
e)pika/rsios.html: ἐπικάρσιος -η, -ον [ἐπικάρ.] Of ships, app., plunging their bows in the sea, or drifting side-ways, making leeway Od. 9.70.

e)pamoibadi/s.head: ἐπαμοιβαδίς
e)pamoibadi/s.html: ἐπαμοιβαδίς [ἐπαμοιβα-, ἐπαμείβω. Cf. ἐπημοιβός.] Crossing, interlaced with. With dat.: ἀλλήλοισιν Od. 5.481.

ei)na/lios.head: εἰνάλιος
ei)na/lios.html: εἰνάλιος -η, -ον [εἰν-, ἐν- 1 + ἅλς1.] Inhabiting the sea: κήτεϊ Od. 4.443. Cf. Od. 5.67, Od. 15.479.

e)nqu/mios.head: ἐνθύμιος
e)nqu/mios.html: ἐνθύμιος [ἐν- 1 + θυμός.] Taken to heart Od. 13.421 (a subject of anxiety).

e)piptai/rw.head: †ἐπιπταίρω
e)piptai/rw.html: †ἐπιπταίρω [ἐπι- 4.] 3 sing. aor. ἐπέπταρε. To sneeze at, i.e. as giving a favourable omen to accompany. With dat.: πᾶσι ἔπεσσιν Od. 17.545.

eu)xh/.head: εὐχή
eu)xh/.html: εὐχή -ῆς, ἡ [εὔχομαι.] A prayer Od. 10.526.

e)nneo/rguios.head: ἐννεόργυιος
e)nneo/rguios.html: ἐννεόργυιος [ἐννέα + ὄργυια.] Nine fathoms in extent: μῆκος ἐννεόργυιοι (in . . .) Od. 11.312.

e)pa/gw.head: ἐπάγω
e)pa/gw.html: ἐπάγω [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 17.] Aor. ἐπήγαγον Od. 14.392. 1 Of hunters and their dogs, to drive on the game: ὡς ἐπάγοντες ἐπῇσαν Od. 19.445. 2 To bring into an indicated state of mind, induce to believe something Od. 14.392.

e)urrafh/s.head: ἐϋρραφής
e)urrafh/s.html: ἐϋρραφής [ἐϋ- 1 + ῥαφ-, ῥάπτω.] Well or strongly stitched: ἐϋρραφέεσσι δοροῖσιν Od. 2.354, 380.

e)teo/krhtes.head: Ἐτεόκρητες
e)teo/krhtes.html: Ἐτεόκρητες (μεγαλήτορες). Etymologically, 'the true Cretans.' In Odysseus's tale to Penelope applied to one of the five divisions of the inhabitants of Crete Od. 19.176.

e)pala/omai.head: †ἐπαλάομαι
e)pala/omai.html: †ἐπαλάομαι [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 14.] 3 sing. aor. subj. ἐπαληθῇ Od. 15.401. Pple. ἐπαληθείς Od. 4.81, 83, Od. 15.176. To wander or rove over or among. With acc.: Κύπρον καὶ Αἰγυπτίους Od. 4.83. Cf. Od. 4.81, Od. 15.176, 401.

eu)ruti/wn.head: Εὐρυτίων
eu)ruti/wn.html: Εὐρυτίων (ἀγακλυτός). A centaur. Punished in the house of Peirithous by the Lapiths Od. 21.295.

eu)rumi/dhs.head: Εὐρυμίδης
eu)rumi/dhs.html: Εὐρυμίδης Patronymic of Telemus Od. 9.509.

eu)rufuh/s.head: εὐρυφυής
eu)rufuh/s.html: εὐρυφυής -ές [εὐρύς + φύω.] Broad-eared: κρῖ Od. 4.604 (the grains of barley not being set so close round the central stem of the ear as in wheat).

e)pi/krion.head: ἐπίκριον
e)pi/krion.html: ἐπίκριον τό [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 1 + ἴκρια.] A top or look-out place fitted to the mast at some distance above its base in the ἴκρια Od. 5.254, 318.

e(rmi/s.head: ἑρμίς
e(rmi/s.html: ἑρμίς -ῖνος [app. conn. with ἕρμα1.] A bedpost Od. 8.278, Od. 23.198.

e)remboi/.head: Ἐρεμβοί
e)remboi/.html: Ἐρεμβοί A people, otherwise unknown, visited by Menelaus Od. 4.84.

e)pi/mastos.head: ἐπίμαστος
e)pi/mastos.html: ἐπίμαστος [ἐπιμασ-, ἐπιμαίομαι.] App., sought out, that has been brought (i.e. by Eumaeus), and has not come unasked: ἀλήτην Od. 20.377.

e)pifqone/w.head: ἐπιφθονέω
e)pifqone/w.html: ἐπιφθονέω [ἐπι- 5.] To grudge something to, be disinclined to grant something to: ᾧ κʼ ἐπιφθονέοις, ὁ δʼ εἶσιν ὀπίσσω Od. 11.149.

e)pi/stion.head: ἐπίστιον
e)pi/stion.html: ἐπίστιον τό. A slip on which to haul up a ship Od. 6.265.

e)uplunh/s.head: ἐϋπλυνής
e)uplunh/s.html: ἐϋπλυνής -ές [ἐϋ- 1 + πλύνω.] Well or freshly washed, fair: φᾶρος Od. 8.392, 425, Od. 13.67, Od. 16.173.

e)nsta/zw.head: †ἐνστάζω
e)nsta/zw.html: †ἐνστάζω [ἐν- 2.] 3 sing. pf. pass. ἐνέστακται. To drop into; hence, to instil in. With dat.: εἴ τοι σοῦ πατρὸς ἐνέστακται μένος ἠΰ Od. 2.271.

e)narari/skw.head: †ἐναραρίσκω
e)narari/skw.html: †ἐναραρίσκω [ἐν- 2.] Nom. sing. neut. pf. pple. ἐναρηρός. To be fitted into its place Od. 5.236.

e)nwpadi/ws.head: ἐνωπαδίως
e)nwpadi/ws.html: ἐνωπαδίως [ἐνῶπα.] In the face: ἐσίδεσκεν Od. 23.94.

e)parth/s.head: ἐπαρτής
e)parth/s.html: ἐπαρτής [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 5 + ἀρ-, ἀραρίσκω.] Equipped, ready Od. 8.151, Od. 14.332 = Od. 19.289.

ei)sana/gw.head: εἰσανάγω
ei)sana/gw.html: εἰσανάγω [εἰσ- 2 + ἀν-, ἀνα- 1.] App., to carry off inland, or simply, to carry off, into (a condition) (cf. ἀνάγω 1). With acc.: εἴρερον εἰσανάγουσιν Od. 8.529.

eu)pei/qhs.head: Εὐπείθης
eu)pei/qhs.html: Εὐπείθης Father of Antinous Od. 1.383; leads a section of the Ithacans to attack Odysseus Od. 24.422 , 465, 469, killed by Laertes 523; etc.

e)paoidh/.head: ἐπαοιδή
e)paoidh/.html: ἐπαοιδή -ῆς, ἡ [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 5 + ἀοιδή.] An incantation or charm: ἐπαοιδῂ αἷμʼ ἔσχεθον Od. 19.457.

e)pi/lhqos.head: ἐπίληθος
e)pi/lhqos.html: ἐπίληθος [ἐπιλήθω.] Bringing forgetfulness. With genit.: φάρμακον κακῶν ἐπίληθον Od. 4.221.

e)lehtu/s.head: ἐλεητύς
e)lehtu/s.html: ἐλεητύς ἡ [ἐλεέω.] Compunction in using, sparing: οὔ τις ἐ. ἀλλοτρίων χαρίσασθαι Od. 17.451. Cf. Od. 14.82.

e)lpi/s.head: ἐλπίς
e)lpi/s.html: ἐλπίς -ίδος, ἡ (ϝελπίς) [ἔλπω.] Hope Od. 16.101, Od. 19.84.

e)sfore/w.head: ἐσφορέω
e)sfore/w.html: ἐσφορέω [ἐσ-, εἰσ- 2.] 1 To carry into an indicated place Od. 19.32. 2 To carry into. With acc.: εἵματα μέλαν ὕδωρ Od. 6.91.

eu)rua/dhs.head: Εὐρυάδης
eu)rua/dhs.html: Εὐρυάδης A suitor. Killed by Telemachus Od. 22.267.

e)pirre/zw.head: †ἐπιρρέζω
e)pirre/zw.html: †ἐπιρρέζω [ἐπι- 5.] 3 pl. pa. iterative ἐπιρρέζεσκον. To do sacrifice to an indicated divinity Od. 17.211.

e)pimi/mnw.head: ἐπιμίμνω
e)pimi/mnw.html: ἐπιμίμνω [ἐπι- 2.] To remain or abide at. With dat.: ἔργον ᾧ ἐπιμίμνω Od. 14.66, Od. 15.372.

eu)frosu/nh.head: εὐφροσύνη
eu)frosu/nh.html: εὐφροσύνη ἐϋφροσύνη -ης, ἡ [εὔφρων.] Gladness, happiness, joy, mirth, merriment Od. 9.6, Od. 10.465, Od. 20.8, Od. 23.52. In pl. in sim. sense: θυμός σθισιν ἐϋφροσύνῃσιν ἰαίνεται Od. 6.156.

e)/mporos.head: ἔμπορος
e)/mporos.html: ἔμπορος -ου, ὁ [ἐμ-, ἐν- 1 + πορ-, περάω1.] One who travels in a ship belonging to another, a passenger Od. 2.319, Od. 24.300.

e)phetano/s.head: ἐπηετανός
e)phetano/s.html: ἐπηετανός -όν [prob. ἐπ-, ἐπι- 16 + ηε- = αἰεί + suff. -τανος. Lasting for ever.] 1 Never-failing, always available: γάλα Od. 4.89. Unfailing, constant, regularly afforded or given: κομιδή Od. 8.233, σῖτον Od. 18.360. Ever-flowing, always full: πλυνοί Od. 6.86, ἀρδμοί Od. 13.247. 2 In neut. sing. ἐπηετανόν as adv., in never-failing abundance: ἐ. ἔχουσιν Od. 10.427. Cf. Od. 7.99. Ever, all the year round: γανόωσαι Od. 7.128.

e)pigouni/s.head: ἐπιγουνίς
e)pigouni/s.html: ἐπιγουνίς -ίδος, ἡ [ἐπι- 1 + γουν-, γόνυ.] The great extensor muscle of the thigh Od. 17.225, Od. 18.74.

e)neu/naios.head: ἐνεύναιος
e)neu/naios.html: ἐνεύναιος -ον [ἐν- 1, ἐν- 3 + εὐνή.] In or on the bed: αὐτοῦ ἐνεύναιον (sc. δέρμα) (his own bedcovering) Od. 14.51. Absol., app., a sleeper: χήτει ἐνευναίων Od. 16.35.

e)pipe/lomai.head: †ἐπιπέλομαι
e)pipe/lomai.html: †ἐπιπέλομαι [ἐπι- 11.] Neut. aor. pple. ἐπιπλόμενον. Of time, to come on or round: ἐπιπλόμενον ἔτος (the pple. adjectivally, revolving) Od. 7.261 = Od. 14.287.

e(te/rws.head: ἑτέρως
e(te/rws.html: ἑτέρως [adv. fr. ἕτερος.] To the opposite effect, otherwise: ἑ. ἐβόλοντο θεοί Od. 1.234.

e)neu/dw.head: ἐνεύδω
e)neu/dw.html: ἐνεύδω [ἐν- 1, ἐν- 3.] 1 To sleep in or upon something Od. 3.350. 2 To sleep in or upon. With dat.: χλαῖναν καὶ κώεα τοῖσιν ἐνεῦδεν Od. 20.95.

eu)kamph/s.head: εὐκαμπής
eu)kamph/s.html: εὐκαμπής -ές [εὐ- 1 + κάμπτω.] Curved into due form, fashioned with art or skill Od. 18.368, Od. 21.6.

eu)ru/loxos.head: Εὐρύλοχος
eu)ru/loxos.html: Εὐρύλοχος (θεοειδής, μεγαλήτωρ ). A comrade of Odysseus in his ship. Leads one half of the ship's company to Circe's house Od. 10.205, remains when the others enter 232, tells their fate 244, follows Odysseus to the house 447; at the sacrifice on the borders of Oceanus Od. 11.23; with Perimedes-2 binds Odysseus more firmly at the Sirens' island Od. 12.195 ; insists on landing at the island of the oxen of the Sun Od. 12.278; etc.

e)fo/lkaion.head: ἐφόλκαιον
e)fo/lkaion.html: ἐφόλκαιον τό [ἐφ-, ἐπι- 12 + ὁλκ-, ἕλκω.] Prob., a ship's lading-plank: ἑφόλκαιον καταβάς Od. 14.350.

e)pidhmeu/w.head: ἐπιδημεύω
e)pidhmeu/w.html: ἐπιδημεύω [ἐπι- 2 + δῆμος in sense town. Cf. πανδήμιος.] To dwell or remain in the city Od. 16.28.

e)phtu/s.head: ἐπητύς
e)phtu/s.html: ἐπητύς, -ύος, ἡ [ἐπητής.] Courtesy, gentle usage Od. 21.306.

e)/kfhmi.head: †ἔκφημι
e)/kfhmi.html: †ἔκφημι [ἐκ- 8.] Infin. mid. ἐκφάσθαι. 1 To announce or declare openly. With dependent clause: οὕνεκα...ν 308. 2 To utter: ἔπος Od. 10.246.

e)pafu/ssw.head: †ἐπαφύσσω
e)pafu/ssw.html: †ἐπαφύσσω [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 6.] 3 sing. aor. ἐπήφυσε. To draw (water) from a vessel and add it to the contents of another vessel: θερμὸν [ὕδωρ] Od. 19.388.

eu)=gma.head: εὖγμα
eu)=gma.html: εὖγμα -ατος, τό [εὐγ-, εὔχομαι.] A boast or vaunt: κενὰ εὔγματα εἰπών Od. 22.249.

e)pigignw/skw.head: †ἐπιγιγνώσκω
e)pigignw/skw.html: †ἐπιγιγνώσκω [ἐπι- 5.] 3 sing. aor. subj. ἐπιγνώῃ Od. 24.217. 3 pl. ἐπιγνώωσι Od. 18.30. 1 To look upon, watch, see Od. 18.30. 2 To recognize Od. 24.217.

e)pi/spastos.head: ἐπίσπαστος
e)pi/spastos.html: ἐπίσπαστος [ἐπισπασ-, ἐπισπάω, fr. ἐπι- 5 + σπάω.] Brought upon oneself, such as one has oneself to thank for: κακόν Od. 18.73, Od. 24.462.

e)pilei/bw.head: ἐπιλείβω
e)pilei/bw.html: ἐπιλείβω [ἐπι- 12.] To make a libation upon something specified: ἀνιστάμενοι ἐπέλειβον Od. 3.341.

e)partu/w.head: ἐπαρτύω
e)partu/w.html: ἐπαρτύω [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 3.] To fit or fix on Od. 8.447.

ei)soixne/w.head: †εἰσοιχνέω
ei)soixne/w.html: †εἰσοιχνέω [εἰσ- 1.] 3 pl. εἰσοιχνεῦσι Od. 9.120. Acc. sing. fem. pple. εἰσοιχνεῦσαν Od. 6.157. With acc., to go to, land upon: νῆσον Od. 9.120. To approach in order to take part in: χορόν Od. 6.157.

ei)/sodos.head: εἴσοδος
ei)/sodos.html: εἴσοδος ἡ [εἰσ- 2 + ὁδός.] An entrance Od. 10.90.

e)cagoreu/w.head: ἐξαγορεύω
e)cagoreu/w.html: ἐξαγορεύω [ἐξ 9.] To declare, tell Od. 11.234.

ei)/reros.head: εἴρερος
ei)/reros.html: εἴρερος (σείρερος) [(σ)είρω1.] Slavery Od. 8.529.

e)popi/zomai.head: ἐποπίζομαι
e)popi/zomai.html: ἐποπίζομαι [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 5.] To have regard for, respect, shrink from incurring: Διὸς μῆνιν Od. 5.146.

e)/fudros.head: ἔφυδρος
e)/fudros.html: ἔφυδρος [ἐφ-, ἐπι- 8 + ὕδωρ.] Coming with, bringing, rain: ζέφυρος Od. 14.458.

e)piboa/w.head: †ἐπιβοάω
e)piboa/w.html: †ἐπιβοάω [ἐπι- 5.] Fut. mid. ἐπιβώσομαι Od. 1.378, Od. 2.143. 1 pl. ἐπιβωσόμεθα (v.l. ἐπιδωσόμεθα) Il. 10.463. In mid., with acc., to call to for aid: θεούς Od. 1.378 = Od. 2.143. App., to call to in thanksgiving: Ἀθήνην Il. 10.463.

e)mplh/gdhn.head: ἐμπλήγδην
e)mplh/gdhn.html: ἐμπλήγδην [ἐμπλήσσω = ἐνιπλήσσω.] In striking wise, mightily: ἐ. ἕτερόν γε τίει Od. 20.132.

e)u/pleios.head: ἐΰπλειος
e)u/pleios.html: ἐΰπλειος -ον [ἐϋ- 4 + πλεῖος.] Well-filled Od. 17.467.

e)kti/qhmi.head: †ἐκτίθημι
e)kti/qhmi.html: †ἐκτίθημι [ἐκ- 1.] Nom. pl. fem. aor. pple. ἐκθεῖσαι. To place outside on a spot indicated: λέχος Od. 23.179.

e)pa/rouros.head: ἐπάρουρος
e)pa/rouros.html: ἐπάρουρος [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 1 + ἄρουρα.] Of a hired labourer, app. attached in some way to a particular piece of land or estate Od. 11.489.

e)mfore/w.head: ἐμφορέω
e)mfore/w.html: ἐμφορέω [ἐμ-, ἐν- 1.] In pass., to be borne or carried about in. With dat.: κύμασιν ἐμφορέοντο Od. 12.419 = Od. 14.309.

e)cafaire/w.head: †ἐξαφαιρέω
e)cafaire/w.html: †ἐξαφαιρέω [ἐξ- 1 + ἀφ-, ἀπο- 1.] 2 pl. aor. subj. mid. ἐξαφέλησθε. To take away from. In mid. With genit.: πασέων ψυχάς Od. 22.444.

e)retmeu/s.head: Ἐρετμεύς
e)retmeu/s.html: Ἐρετμεύς A Phaeacian Od. 8.112 .

e)nerei/dw.head: ἐνερείδω
e)nerei/dw.html: ἐνερείδω [ἐν- 2.] 3 pl. aor. ἐνέρεισαν. To press or thrust into. With dat.: μοχλὸν ὀφθαλμῷ Od. 9.383.

e)popta/w.head: ἐποπτάω
e)popta/w.html: ἐποπτάω [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 1.] To roast upon something indicated: ἐπώπτων ἔγκατα Od. 12.363.

e)ci/sxw.head: ἐξίσχω
e)ci/sxw.html: ἐξίσχω [ἐξ- 1.] To hold or keep outside: ἔξω ἐξίσχει κεφαλὰς βερέθρου Od. 12.94.

eu)mene/ths.head: εὐμενέτης
eu)mene/ths.html: εὐμενέτης [εὐ- 5 + μένος.] A well-wisher: χάρματʼ εὐμενέτῃσιν Od. 6.185.

eu)ru/maxos.head: Εὐρύμαχος
eu)ru/maxos.html: Εὐρύμαχος (θεοειδής, πεπνυμένος ). Son of Polybus-2. With Antinous leader of the suitors. In the Ithacan assembly threatens Halitherses Od. 2.177 ; Penelope urged to marry him Od. 15.17; falsely comforts Penelope Od. 16.434; his gift to Penelope Od. 18.295; abuses the disguised Odysseus Od. 18.349, throws a stool at him 387; cannot string the bow Od. 21.245; addresses Odysseus on the slaying of Antinous Od. 22.44; heads the suitors Od. 22.69, slain by Odysseus Ο. Od. 22.81; etc.

e)/klhsis.head: ἔκλησις
e)/klhsis.html: ἔκλησις ἡ [ἐκ- 9 + λη-, λήθω.] A forgetting: παίδων φόνοιο Od. 24.485 (an amnesty in regard to . . .).

e)caponi/zw.head: ἐξαπονίζω
e)caponi/zw.html: ἐξαπονίζω [ἐξ- 1 + ἀπο- 7.] To wash with water from (a vessel). With genit.: λέβητα, τοῦ πόδας ἐξαπένιζεν Od. 19.387.

eu)ergo/s.head: εὐεργός
eu)ergo/s.html: εὐεργός -όν [εὐ- 2 + ἔργω2.] Doing what is right, of good walk and conversation Od. 11.434 = Od. 15.422 = Od. 24.202.

e)sqh/s.head: ἐσθής
e)sqh/s.html: ἐσθής -ῆτος, ἡ [ϝές-νυμι, ἕννυμι.] 1 Clothing, raiment Od. 1.165, Od. 2.339, Od. 5.38 = Od. 23.341, Od. 6.192, Od. 8.440, Od. 13.136 = Od. 16.231, Od. 14.510, Od. 15.207, Od. 24.67. Of bed-clothing Od. 23.290. 2 Articles of clothing, clothes: ἐσθῆτα ἔσφερον Od. 7.6. Cf. Od. 6.74, 83.

e)/mbruon.head: ἔμβρυον
e)/mbruon.html: ἔμβρυον τό [ἐμ-, ἐν- 1 + βρύω.] The young of an animal Od. 9.245 = 309 = 342.

e)/kbasis.head: ἔκβασις
e)/kbasis.html: ἔκβασις ἡ [ἐκ- 1 + βα-, βαίνω.] A means of escape from something: ἁλός Od. 5.410.

e)pibouko/los.head: ἐπιβουκόλος
e)pibouko/los.html: ἐπιβουκόλος [ἐπι- 10 + βουκόλος. Pleonastically, the herdsman in charge of (the herd). Cf. ἐπιβώτωρ, ἐπίουρος, ἐπιποιμήν, μετάγγελος.] A herdsman: βοῶν Od. 3.422, Od. 20.235 = Od. 21.199, Od. 22.268, 285, 292.

e)pilhke/w.head: ἐπιληκέω
e)pilhke/w.html: ἐπιληκέω [ἐπι- 8 + ληκ-, λάσκω. To make a sound in accompaniment.] Hence, app., to beat time with the feet Od. 8.379.

ei)si/qmh.head: εἰσίθμη
ei)si/qmh.html: εἰσίθμη ἡ [εἰσ- 2 + ἰθ-, εἶμι.] An entrance Od. 6.264.

e)pibh/twr.head: ἐπιβήτωρ
e)pibh/twr.html: ἐπιβήτωρ -ορος, ὁ [ἐπιβη-, ἐπιβαίνω.] 1 One who mounts (a chariot), a (skilled) fighter from the chariot Od. 18.263. 2 Of an animal, the mounter, the male or mate Od. 11.131 = Od. 23.278.

e(orth/.head: ἑορτή
e(orth/.html: ἑορτή ἡ. A high-day or feast: ἑ. τοῖο θεοῖο (i.e. Apollo) Od. 21.258. Cf. Od. 20.156.

e)rukana/w.head: †ἐρυκανάω
e)rukana/w.html: †ἐρυκανάω [frequentative fr. ἐρύκω.] 3 pl. ἐρυκανόωσι. To hold in restraint, detain Od. 1.199.

eu)a/nqhs.head: Εὐάνθης
eu)a/nqhs.html: Εὐάνθης Father of Maron Od. 9.197 .
